subject: biology-2
question: A researcher traces a group of embryonic cells and finds that they form the brain, spinal cord, and outer layer of skin. From which germ layer did these cells most likely come?

options.text: The mesoderm, which forms muscle and blood.
The endoderm, which forms the gut lining.
The yolk sac, an extraembryonic membrane.
The ectoderm, which forms the nervous system and skin.

explanation: The ectoderm gives rise to the nervous system (the brain and spinal cord) and the outer layer of skin, exactly the derivatives the researcher traced. A and B name layers whose derivatives are muscle and blood or the gut lining. C is an extraembryonic membrane, not a germ layer of the embryo.
